steps.title: Configure Project Environment and Manifest
steps.description: Configure Gradle build parameters, compile options for Java 8, and define application manifest with activities and permissions.

steps.title: Setup App Metadata and API Schemas
steps.description: Define application identifier, offline data models, and local operational schema definitions.

steps.title: Create Color Schemes and UI Theme Resources
steps.description: Establish custom color palettes, dimension values, styles, and string resources for the grocery POS interface.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Engine and Domain Entities
steps.description: Construct SQLiteOpenHelper database management layer and models for products, customers, transactions, purchases, and expenses.

steps.title: Build Dashboard Activity and Real-Time Business Overview
steps.description: Implement MainActivity layout and logic displaying daily sales summary, pending udhaar, low stock indicators, and quick POS navigation.

steps.title: Implement Grocery Inventory Catalog and Management
steps.description: Design layouts and activities for searching, adding, editing, and deleting inventory items with cost and selling price tracking.

steps.title: Build Customer Ledger and Khata Credit System
steps.description: Develop customer registration, khata balance overview, repayment collection, and audit history ledger.

steps.title: Implement POS Billing and Cart Checkout System
steps.description: Construct dynamic cart builder supporting quantity alterations, customer selection, instant discount calculation, and multi-mode payment handling.

steps.title: Design Printable Invoice and Sale Receipt Screen
steps.description: Create detailed digital invoice breakdown layout displaying store branding, line items, taxes/discounts, and payment receipt details.

steps.title: Build Supplier Procurement and Stock Inward Workflow
steps.description: Develop purchase tracking module for recording stock inward deliveries, supplier invoices, and stock replenishment.

steps.title: Build Store Operating Expenses Tracker
steps.description: Implement daily expense logger categorizing store overheads like rent, utility bills, packaging, and employee wages.

steps.title: Implement Analytics, Net Profit Calculation, and CSV Data Export
steps.description: Build financial performance analytics calculating net profit margins and an offline CSV data exporter for complete store backups.

steps.title: Building Al Faris Kirana
steps.description: Assemble, compile, and package the final native Android APK for Al Faris Kirana store management.
